title: Reflective Practice
hero_prompt: A wide sumi-e ink-wash painting of a woman musician mid-gesture at an instrument, her form doubled in a rippling pool of water beneath her that holds her reflection a half-second behind her real motion. Loose, wet-brush strokes, bold negative space, muted charcoal-grey wash. No letters, numerals, words, labels, or inscriptions — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: A bold sumi-e brushstroke emblem: a single thick black ink circle (an enso) with a fine ripple-line reflection beneath it, rendered as a stark high-contrast silhouette. No fine linework beyond the one bold ripple, no letters or text.
